metadata.question: Does the plume at (69.264212, -136.275745) discharged by the Mackenzie River into the Beaufort Sea apprear more milky compared to the adjacent open ocean (69.803894, -137.786365) waters in July 19, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Two locations: plume at (69.264212, -136.275745) and open ocean at (69.803894, -137.786365) - Date: July 19, 2017 - Need optical imagery (Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8) to assess "milky" appearance - Milky water typically means higher sediment/turbidity = higher reflectance in visible bands 2. Masking strategy: - Should NOT mask clouds heavily since we want to see the water appearance - Light cloud masking if needed, but question is about visual appearance of water - Focus on water reflectance/turbidity indicators 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid comparison: Both locations have valid reflectance values - Milky = higher reflectance (especially red/green bands) or turbidity - A: Plume has significantly higher reflectance than open ocean - B: No significant difference or open ocean has higher reflectance - C1: No images available for the date - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const plumePoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-136.275745, 69.264212]); const oceanPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-137.786365, 69.803894]); const date = '2017-07-19'; const dateStart = ee.Date(date); const dateEnd = dateStart.advance(1, 'day'); // Buffer points for sampling const plumeRegion = plumePoint.buffer(500); const oceanRegion = oceanPoint.buffer(500); // 2. Data Acquisition - Try Sentinel-2 first let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(plumePoint.union(oceanPoint)); let collSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${collSize}`); // Fallback to Landsat 8 if no Sentinel-2 if (collSize === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8...'); collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(plumePoint.union(oceanPoint)); collSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images found: ${collSize}`); } if (collSize === 0) { console.log('No images available for this date and location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing let image; if (collection.first().bandNames().getInfo().includes('B4')) { // Sentinel-2 image = collection.first().select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']); // Blue, Green, Red } else { // Landsat 8 image = collection.first().select(['SR_B2', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B4']); // Blue, Green, Red } // Calculate mean reflectance for turbidity assessment const plumeStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: plumeRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const oceanStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: oceanRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); console.log('Plume stats:', JSON.stringify(plumeStats)); console.log('Ocean stats:', JSON.stringify(oceanStats)); // Get band names (different for Sentinel-2 and Landsat) const bands = Object.keys(plumeStats).filter(k => k.includes('mean')); if (bands.length === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Check pixel counts const countKey = Object.keys(plumeStats).find(k => k.includes('count')); const plumeCount = plumeStats[countKey]; const oceanCount = oceanStats[countKey]; if (plumeCount === 0 || oceanCount === 0) { console.log(`Pixel counts - Plume: ${plumeCount}, Ocean: ${oceanCount}`); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation - Average reflectance across visible bands let plumeReflectance = 0; let oceanReflectance = 0; for (const band of bands) { const plumeVal = plumeStats[band]; const oceanVal = oceanStats[band]; if (plumeVal == null || oceanVal == null || isNaN(plumeVal) || isNaN(oceanVal)) { console.log('Calculation failed: null or NaN values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } plumeReflectance += plumeVal; oceanReflectance += oceanVal; } plumeReflectance /= bands.length; oceanReflectance /= bands.length; // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Plume avg reflectance: ${plumeReflectance.toFixed(2)}, Pixels: ${plumeCount}`); console.log(`Ocean avg reflectance: ${oceanReflectance.toFixed(2)}, Pixels: ${oceanCount}`); // Milky appearance means higher reflectance (more turbid/sediment-laden) const difference = plumeReflectance - oceanReflectance; console.log(`Difference (plume - ocean): ${difference.toFixed(2)}`); if (difference > 100) { // Threshold for "more milky" console.log('Plume appears more milky than open ocean.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Plume does not appear significantly more milky.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
